title: SAP Commerce/Hybris Lead developer
jobDescription:
SAP Commerce/Hybris Lead developer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced SAP Commerce Cloud Developer/Consultant to join our digital team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining our e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2). You will work closely with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and integration partners to deliver scalable, high-performance B2B/B2C commerce solutions. Key Responsibilities Development & Customization: Develop, customize, and extend SAP Commerce Cloud applications using Java, Spring Framework, and SAP-specific extensions. Headless Commerce: Build and maintain headless storefronts using Spartacus (Angular/Type Script) and integrate them via REST/OData APIs. Data & Configuration: Write and maintain complex Impex scripts, Flexible Search queries, and manage Backoffice configurations. Integrations: Design and implement integrations between SAP Commerce Cloud and backend systems (SAP S/4HANA, SAP ERP, SAP CI/CPI, OMS, Payment Gateways, PIM). Cloud Management: Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications in the SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) environment using the Merchant Center / Cloud Portal and HAC. Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Code Quality: Conduct peer code reviews, write unit tests, and ensure adherence to SAP best practices and coding standards. Support & Optimization: Provide L3 support, perform performance tuning, and troubleshoot complex production issues. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience: [4-6+] years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development and implementation. Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Java (J2EE), Spring Framework, Hibernate, and object-oriented design. SAP Commerce Expertise: Deep understanding of SAP Commerce data models, extension framework, Impex, Flexible Search, Backoffice, and WCMS (Smart Edit). Accelerators: Experience working with SAP Commerce B2B and/or B2C Accelerators. Frontend / Headless: Solid experience with Spartacus (Angular) or traditional SAP Commerce frontend (JSP/Tag files, Angular JS). Integration Skills: Experience with RESTful APIs, SOAP, OData, and integration middleware (SAP Cloud Integration / CPI is a strong plus). Database: Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., SAP HANA, My SQL, Oracle). Methodology: Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have) Certifications: SAP Certified Development Professional – SAP Commerce Cloud Developer. Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the broader SAP Customer Experience (CX) suite, including SAP CPQ, SAP Emarsys, or SAP Service Cloud. CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, and Cloud Foundry. Domain Experience: Previous experience in the [Retail / Manufacturing / Wholesale / etc.] industry. If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. Commitment to reaching all kinds of people We design experiences that work for all kinds of people
- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all. The benefits This is a [Fulltime] position based in [Bangalore] . Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer: Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. Your application process Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com . We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. About Valtech Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world. At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more. At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate. Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us. Let’s connect Let’s connect Fill in your details and kickstart your transformation journey. Should you need an alternative format and/or communication support to provide feedback please contact Sheree Atcheson .
